g.text: Efficiency does not come from making each asset faster.
It comes from making components once and recombining them.
One illustrative example runs through this deck: a seasonal skincare launch film, briefed once. It is an example chosen to explain the mechanism, not a description of your brief.
C · OUTPUTS, ASSEMBLED FROM THOSE COMPONENTS

26 component slots filled across 6 outputs. 9 components actually produced.

modularly, hours saved, or cost saved?
Until that is agreed we show the mechanism here and put no number on it.
Needed from: the commercial lead, before submission.
